metadata.project: Chronic Cardiovascular Risk Analysis using Wearable Biosensors and Clinical Data
metadata.description: Clinical scoring results for 1026 test-set patients. 3-class DST risk stratification.

field_descriptions.alpha_1: Layer 1 Elastic Net clinical risk score
field_descriptions.conflict_mass_K: DST conflict mass — mild-zone patients have higher K
field_descriptions.prob_low_risk: P(Low) — Gaussian CDF at T1=0.15, sigma=u_1
field_descriptions.prob_mild_risk: P(Mild) — CDF mass between T1 and T2
field_descriptions.correct: True if prediction matches true class
field_descriptions.flagged_for_review: True if K >= 0.40 — escalate to cardiologist
